notes:
BUILD 85
- Jobs at the Outpost. A job board stands in the yard near the shops: E on it shows three jobs, one of each kind, changed every quarter of an hour. One job at a time, paid in scrap.
- Supply run: bring a number of some item back to the board.
- Raid: kill so many scientists at a named monument, then come back to the board for the money.
- Delivery: you are handed a sealed package to carry to another monument, and paid the moment you arrive with it.
- The job in hand shows at the top left and as a J on the compass. A job is not kept if you close the game.
- The Outpost has a motor pool inside the side gate: three roofed bays against the east wall, marked places in front, two fuel pumps, and a Garage machine selling low grade fuel, a wrench, a jack and regular engine parts.
- Outboards start now (R), their hatch is at the stern by the motor, and an engine panel only shows the slots that engine uses: three on boats and the bike.
- The truck's front wheels no longer cut into the cab.
- /clear vehicles (dev) removes every vehicle on the map.
